content.text:
I submitted **index 26 (Sb fraction 0.774)** as the best composition. It gave the highest EQE I measured, **0.0303%**. I used all 5 EQE measurements and none of the 5 XRD measurements.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 12 | 0.316 | 0.00021 |
| 22 | 0.669 (MgSb₂O₆ composition) | 0.0031 |
| 26 | 0.774 | **0.0303** |
| 27 | 0.795 | 0.0245 |
| 28 | 0.816 (end of the line) | 0.0271 |

- **Trend:** EQE is very low on the Mg-rich side and climbs about tenfold between 0.669 and 0.774. The best region is the Sb-rich end, above the composition of the one stable Mg–Sb oxide (MgSb₂O₆).
- **Uncertainty:** Indices 26, 27 and 28 are close (0.024–0.030%), and the lower value at 27 sitting between two higher ones may just be measurement noise. The true best could be index 23–25 (Sb 0.69–0.74), which I didn't measure.
- **Not confirmed:** I had planned to use XRD to check whether the phase changes between 0.67 and 0.77, but didn't run it. The explanation that the Sb-rich films are MgSb₂O₆ mixed with an Sb oxide is therefore unconfirmed.
